Hi Olga,

Thanks for the demo last week — the platform looks promising. Before we finalize the order form we'd like to lock in bespoke retention and deletion commitments for patient-identifiable inference traces used in our test and production environments. A few specific asks: 

- Can Redwood provide a contractual retention window of 30 days for inference logs in hot storage, and a separate 90-day window for immutable backups used only for disaster recovery?
- On customer-initiated offboarding, what is the guaranteed timeline to fully purge all copies (primary, cache, and backups) and can Redwood provide a signed attestation of deletion?
- Are there any exceptions where data would remain longer (legal hold, troubleshooting snapshotting)? If so, how would that be documented in the order form?

We prefer short bullet points in the SLA language so procurement can review quickly. Attaching our standard security questionnaire separately — happy to hop on a call if easier.

Hi Ava / Olga — attaching a draft SLA snippet for your review (SLA_redwood_proposal_v1.docx). High-level proposal:

1) Retention windows (per account)
   - Hot inference logs (primary serving storage): 30 days
   - Cold DR backups (immutable snapshot storage): 90 days unless Customer requests accelerated purge within the first 30 days after termination (see section 3)

2) Offboarding & purge timeline
   - Customer-initiated termination: Redwood will execute a certified purge of all account-associated primary data and KV caches within 72 hours of termination acceptance.
   - Backup expiration: For immutable backups, Redwood will schedule the deletion at the next backup retention checkpoint; customer may request an expedited deletion which we will execute within 30 calendar days, subject to verification steps below.

3) Certification & verification
   - Redwood will provide a deletion attestation report within 10 business days after purge completion, including the list of logical datasets removed and a cryptographic hash of post-purge verification logs (redacted for internal-only traces).
   - Exceptions: legal hold or active litigation will pause purge timelines; any exception will be documented with the account owner and CS lead and require written notice.

Open questions for engineering (Rishi):
- Can we guarantee 72h for caches + primary across both Hosted and Dedicated?
- For immutable backups that are stored on cloud-provider-managed object storage with lifecycle rules, is 30 days expedited deletion feasible operationally?

Priya
Sr. Privacy Counsel, Redwood Inference

Thanks — technical confirmations below. Quoting Priya above for context.

- Hot serving data (inference logs + KV cache): we can implement a same-account purge pipeline that removes live data within 72 hours of a termination signal for Hosted customers. For Dedicated pools we need to schedule an automated job; SLA still achievable but will be conditional on the committed capacity window in the order form.

- Immutable backups: many customers use object-store lifecycle + immutable snapshots. For a guaranteed expedited deletion within 30 days we need to add an operational step: a manual snapshot invalidation and a cloud provider deletion request. This is operationally feasible but we should capture an "expedited deletion fee" in the order form to cover manual work and potential egress costs if copies are archived across regions.

- Verification attestation: we can provide a signed PDF report and a log extract proving the deletion run executed (timestamps, job ids). For extra assurance we can offer a third-party deletion certificate (SOC-type attestation) as an add-on.

Suggested SLA language to include verbatim in the order form:
"Redwood will, upon Customer-initiated account termination, complete removal of all primary live inference logs and caches within seventy-two (72) hours. Deletion of immutable backups will be scheduled in accordance with the agreed backup retention window; Customer may request expedited deletion which Redwood will complete within thirty (30) calendar days subject to an agreed expedited deletion fee. Redwood will provide a deletion attestation within ten (10) business days of completion."

I'll also flag that for accounts requiring data residency in a specific region we must ensure backup store and deletion procedures are regionally scoped; otherwise cross-region copies may add latency to purge windows.

— Rishi
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

Consolidated proposal (to drop into order form):
- Retention: Hot inference logs (primary) — 30 days. Immutable backups (DR snapshots) — 90 days.
- Offboarding purge: Redwood will execute a certified purge of primary data and in-memory/KV caches within 72 hours of the Customer-initiated termination effective date.

- Attestation: Redwood will provide a deletion attestation report within 10 business days of purge completion. Exceptions (legal hold) will be documented and will pause delete timelines.
